subject: Quick question about service details
text:
Hi Professor,

Sorry for the fast message; I am scrambling to finalize the workshop details. Could you clarify whether the lecture-capture service records both audio and slide notes, or only screen activity? I also need to know if student questions can be submitted anonymously through it. I mentioned a short checklist, but I think the attachment got dropped. If you can resend it, or simply note the main limitations, that would help before we confirm the booking.
